sources.title: Execution of Follow-on Investment (Third Tranche) in OpenAI

event.title: OpenAI investment from SoftBank, NVIDIA and Amazon (February 2026)
event.summary: OpenAI announced $110 billion in new investment at a $730 billion pre-money valuation, including $30 billion from SoftBank, $30 billion from NVIDIA and $50 billion from Amazon. This money is part of the funding round that OpenAI closed in March.

amounts.label: New investment
amounts.quote: Today we're announcing $110B in new investment at a $730B pre-money valuation.

amounts.label: Pre-money valuation
amounts.quote: Today we're announcing $110B in new investment at a $730B pre-money valuation.

amounts.label: SoftBank
amounts.quote: This includes $30B from SoftBank, $30B from NVIDIA, and $50B from Amazon.

amounts.label: NVIDIA
amounts.quote: This includes $30B from SoftBank, $30B from NVIDIA, and $50B from Amazon.

amounts.label: Amazon
amounts.quote: This includes $30B from SoftBank, $30B from NVIDIA, and $50B from Amazon.

amounts.label: SoftBank's earlier investments
amounts.quote: SBG has invested an aggregate of USD 34.6 billion in OpenAI through SoftBank Vision Fund 2 since September 2024.

amounts.label: SoftBank's total investment after the third tranche
amounts.quote: As a result, SBG's cumulative investment in OpenAI totals USD 64.6 billion, and its ownership interest is approximately 13%.

quantities.label: NVIDIA dedicated inference capacity
quantities.quote: We are also expanding our long standing collaboration with NVIDIA, including the use of 3 GW of dedicated inference capacity and 2 GW of training on Vera Rubin systems.

quantities.label: NVIDIA training capacity on Vera Rubin systems
quantities.quote: We are also expanding our long standing collaboration with NVIDIA, including the use of 3 GW of dedicated inference capacity and 2 GW of training on Vera Rubin systems.

facts.label: More investors
facts.text: OpenAI expected more financial investors to join as the round went on.
facts.quote: Additional financial investors are expected to join as the round progresses.

facts.label: Amazon and NVIDIA
facts.text: OpenAI also signed a strategic partnership with Amazon and secured inference compute with NVIDIA.
facts.quote: We've also signed a strategic partnership with Amazon and secured next generation inference compute with NVIDIA.

facts.label: OpenAI Foundation stake
facts.text: OpenAI says the round raises the value of the OpenAI Foundation's stake in OpenAI Group to over $180 billion.
facts.quote: The valuation from this new round increases the value of the OpenAI Foundation's stake in OpenAI Group to over $180 billion, further strengthening what was already one of the most well-resourced nonprofits in history, and expands its capacity to fund philanthropy in areas such as health breakthroughs and AI resilience.

facts.label: SoftBank agreement
facts.text: SoftBank signed a definitive agreement on February 27, 2026 (U.S. time) to invest USD 30.0 billion through SoftBank Vision Fund 2.
facts.quote: SoftBank Group Corp. ("SBG") today announced that, on February 27, 2026 (U.S. time), it entered into a definitive agreement with OpenAI Group PBC ("OpenAI"), a U.S.-based company, to participate in OpenAI's fundraising round, and to make follow-on investments of USD 30.0 billion (JPY 4,674.3 billion*1) via SoftBank Vision Fund 2 (the "Follow-on Investment").

facts.label: SoftBank tranches
facts.text: SoftBank planned three tranches of USD 10 billion on April 1, July 1 and October 1, 2026 (Japan time).
facts.quote: Investment by SBG USD 10 billion USD 10 billion USD 10 billion SBG's investment timing April 1, 2026 (Japan time) July 1, 2026 (Japan time) October 1, 2026 (Japan time)

facts.label: Securities
facts.text: SoftBank receives preferred shares that convert into OpenAI common shares upon an IPO or a related listing.
facts.quote: Type of securities to be acquired Preferred Shares (automatically convertible into common shares of OpenAI upon an IPO or related listing transaction)

facts.label: Closing conditions
facts.text: SoftBank's investment was subject to customary closing conditions.
facts.quote: The Follow-on Investment is subject to the satisfaction of customary closing conditions.

facts.label: SoftBank completed
facts.text: SoftBank says it completed the USD 30.0 billion investment with the third tranche on October 1, 2026 (Japan time).
facts.quote: Following the Third Tranche Investment, SBG has now completed the USD 30.0 billion follow-on investments in OpenAI previously announced.

relations.note: This investment is counted in the funding round that OpenAI closed on March 31, 2026.
